translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent across the set.

'inspirational mush' -> 'papilla inspiracional' (keeps the disparaging tone; a reviewer may prefer 'palabrería inspiracional'). 'grey area tools' -> 'herramientas de zona gris'.
Product/brand names kept (LinkedIn, X, Veyrais, n8n, Make, Notion, Buffer, Canva). 'X' left as the platform name.
Prices unchanged: '1.000 y 5.000 dólares', '50 a 300 dólares'.
